blog.title: PushProof: every push, proven and billed
blog.description: Stamp each snow push with time, GPS, and a photo so disputed per-push invoices get settled with evidence — then export billing-ready CSVs.

body.text: Per-push snow billing dies at one moment: the property manager asks "prove the push happened" and you have nothing stamped. PushProof gives you a timestamped, GPS-stamped record for every push, plus the photo to back it up.

Add your properties with their per-push rate. When a storm rolls in, start a storm event. After each push, tap one button: PushProof stamps the time and your GPS location, lets you snap a photo and log salt used. At the end of the storm you get per-property billing totals and a CSV of every push with coordinates.

items: Independent snow contractors billing per push

Download the CSV or mark pushes billed

body.text: PushProof is $12 a month, or $60 for six months. Pay the admin, request your unlock PIN, and the tool opens up for your whole subscription. Everything runs in your browser — your records and photos stay on your device.
